sourceTitle: Salmon With A Spicy Tomato Sauce
sourceText:
Salmon With A Spicy Tomato Sauce
By: Julie Webster
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:10am

Ingredients




1 tablespoon Organic Sesame Oil1
2/3 pound Salmon fillet
1 cup chopped red onion
2 teaspoons minced peeled fresh garlic
3/4 teaspoon whole anise seed
1/4 teaspoon dried crushed red chili peppers
3 plum tomatoes, seeded
2 tablespoons tamari sauce2
1 1/2 tablespoons agave nectar3

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add salmon, skin side down, cook 2 minutes. Cover pan; cook salmon 2 minutes longer. Transfer salmon, skin side down, to baking dish. Place in oven; cook until just opaque in center, about 8 minutes. 2 Meanwhile, in the same skillet over medium heat, add onions and next 3 ingredients; sautè until onion is golden, about 5 minutes. Stir in tomatoes, tamari sauce, and agave. Increase heat to medium-high and cook mixture until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally, about 3-4 minutes. 3 Divide salmon between plates and top with sauce and enjoy!

About


This is a modification of a recipe I found in Bon Appetite a few years ago. It is very easy to make and has a wonderful spicy taste. The sauce would also be great on halibut or any hardy white fish. I serve it with sautèed spinach with garlic and shallots.  I have many other easy nutritious recipes on my blog:  http://healthandnutritionexperts.wordpress.com
